# GetChannelDoppler <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetChannelDoppler:Float32 channel:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [EmitSound](EmitSound). |

**Returns:** The scale, `1` for a channel that is over.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Tells the doppler scale of one channel that [ChannelDoppler](ChannelDoppler) has set. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print GetChannelDoppler(channel)
```
